verdict.rationale: Gitea documents a code review screen for Pull Request and AGit workflows, where reviewers browse code online and leave comments. That covers basic diff review. Nothing in the evidence addresses handling large diffs or surfacing third-party code quality reports in the review view; Gitea Actions CI exists, but no integration of its results into the review UI is shown. Missing for 10: evidence of large-diff review support, display of third-party code quality reports in the review screen, independent hands-on corroboration.
